piano.preloadPolicy: Always preload default piano; preload representative low/mid/high samples when piano is active; add sequencer lane min/max/mid samples before rendering piano lanes.
piano.onDemandPolicy: Manual and generated piano notes resolve to the nearest fixed Product Core piano asset ID. Hosts may register additional nearest samples on demand; Product Core reports missing asset telemetry instead of synthesizing fallback piano audio.

policies.natureSceneLayers: Snapshots carry enabled soundscape asset refs and levels. Product Core owns looping, crossfade, deterministic random start, and per-texture level/pan/playback-rate policy.
policies.missingAssetTelemetry: If a referenced piano or soundscape asset is absent, Product Core increments asset_missing_count, sets KESSHO_PRODUCT_ERROR_MISSING_ASSET, and does not fake host playback.

decodeMatrix.fallback: Fetch/decode failure leaves the asset unregistered; Product Core missing-asset telemetry owns the audio fallback.
